decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: Nearest-neighbor spacing is mildly increased and clustering mildly reduced but remain inside the frozen envelope. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 02 as the single mask-condition handoff.
